text: ∀x (Employee(x) ∧ (WorkedAtCompanyForAtLeastTwoYears(x) ∧ GoodPerformanceRecord(x) ∨ ∃y (Supervisor(y) ∧ RecommendationFrom(x, y))) → EligibleForPromotion(x)) ::: To be eligible for a promotion, an employee must have worked at the company for at least two years and have a good performance record, unless they have a recommendation from a supervisor.
